cases.text: I had chest pain yesterday whereas my friend has difficulty breathing.
I had chest pain yesterday whereas I have difficulty breathing.
我昨天胸痛然而我呼吸困難。
I was fine yesterday whereas I have chest pain.

ownershipRules: Every symptom has one predicate owner
Every operator has one predicate owner inside its bounded span
Unrelated past and outcome predicates cannot retire a current predicate
Quotation references and reported speakers require explicit links
Shared negation and resolution govern only proven coordinated lists
Conditional and topic exclusions remain local; epistemic scope is possible
